description: Complete user profile ecosystem (PRF-01, MY-01, MY-02, PRF-20, PRF-03, PRF-04): build account menu with sections (My Listings, Favorites, Saved Searches, My Jobs, My Offers, Settings, Help, Logout), implement My Listings with tabs (Active/Drafts/Expired/Sold/Hidden) and card actions (Edit/Boost/Mark Sold/Delete/Relist), implement Edit Listing wizard (same as Add Listing but pre-filled), implement public seller profile with cover, avatar, rating, member since, trust badges, listings grid, reviews list, and Report button, and complete Favorites and Saved Searches list views.
steps: 1. Refactor AccountPage.tsx menu structure: simplify sidebar to sections (Profile, My Activity, Preferences, Support), keep tab routing via /account/:tab but organize tabs into logical groups for better UX.

2. Implement PRF-01 (Profile menu): user info card at top (avatar, name, email), sections with clickable rows: My Listings, Favorites, Saved Searches, My Jobs (applications), My Offers, Settings, Help, Logout; icons per section.

3. Implement MY-01 (My Listings): tab selector (Active/Drafts/Expired/Sold/Hidden); grid of listing cards with status badge + action menu (3-dot icon). Actions: Edit (→ Edit Listing wizard pre-filled), Boost (opens modal with boost duration/cost options), Mark Sold (confirm, update status), Delete (confirm), Relist (copy draft). Empty state if no listings in tab.

4. Implement MY-02 (Edit Listing): reuse AddListingPage wizard but pre-populate all fields from listing; routes to /edit-listing/:id; all 7 steps pre-filled; save button updates listing in myListings; 'Cancel' returns to /account/my-listings.

5. Create SellerProfilePage (PRF-20): header with cover image (or gradient), seller avatar (larger, centered), seller name, rating stars + count, member since year, trust badges (Verified Seller, Fast Responder, etc.), follow button (toggle), description (if available), sections: Listings (grid), Reviews (reviews from sampleReviews filtered by seller), Staff (mocked list with avatars + names), Report button (modal with reason select).

6. Complete FavoritesPage (PRF-03): show ListingCardGrid of favorite listings; each card shows price-at-save vs current price indicator (green if price down, red if up); status badges (Sold/Rented overlay); empty state with 'Browse Listings' link.

7. Complete SavedSearchesPage (PRF-04): show list of saved searches (title, filter summary, alert frequency badge, date saved, delete button); each row is clickable to re-run that search; empty state with 'Start Searching' link; add logic to save new searches (from AccountPage or SearchPage).
8. Add mock data for My Listings: add myListings array to mockData.ts with 5-10 listings in various statuses (active, draft, expired, sold, hidden); each has full details for edit view.
9. Add mock data for Saved Searches: add savedSearches array with 3-5 searches (e.g., 'Toyota Cars in Khartoum', 'Apartments Under 1M'); each has filter object and date.
10. Implement Boost modal (MY-01): show boost options (7-day, 14-day, 30-day) with costs; select one, click 'Boost', confirm success toast and update listing display.
11. Implement Edit confirmation: warn user if unsaved changes before navigating away.
12. Ensure all screens support AR/EN, responsive (mobile-first), loading skeletons, error states (if myListings empty).
acceptance_criteria: AccountPage sidebar shows sections organized by category (Profile, My Activity, Preferences, Support).
My Listings tab shows grid of listings, tabs (Active/Drafts/Expired/Sold/Hidden) filter correctly, 3-dot action menu works (Edit, Boost, Mark Sold, Delete, Relist).
Edit Listing page loads pre-filled form, wizard steps 0-6 show saved data, publish button updates listing, cancel returns to /account/my-listings.

Seller profile page shows cover image, avatar, name, rating stars + count, member since, badges, Follow button (toggles), Listings section with grid, Reviews section, Staff list, Report button (opens modal).
Favorites page shows ListingCardGrid, price-at-save indicator (color coded), status badges, empty state with link to search.
Saved Searches page shows list of searches, each clickable to re-run, alert frequency badge, delete button, empty state with link to start searching.
Boost modal shows 3 duration options, click one, confirm success toast.
All pages AR/EN responsive, loading states, proper error handling.
verification: npm run typecheck — no errors in AccountPage, SellerProfilePage, Edit Listing components.
npm run dev — navigate to /account; sidebar shows sections, My Listings tab active by default.

Click 'My Listings' tab → grid shows 5+ listings with status badges, 3-dot menu on each card, click Edit → pre-filled wizard opens, fill in change, publish → update reflected, cancel → back to /account.
Click 'Favorites' → shows favorite listings with price indicator, empty state if none.
Click 'Saved Searches' → shows saved searches list, delete button works, empty state if none.
Navigate to /seller/Demo%20User (or any seller name) → profile page shows cover, avatar, rating, listings grid, reviews, staff, report button.
Click 'Follow' button → toggles on/off, state persists on refresh (localStorage).
On My Listings, click 3-dot → Boost → modal shows options → select one → success toast.
Switch AR → all text translates, layout mirrors (flex, text-align, avatar alignment).
